injuries.detail: He missed the 4-0 win over Manchester United because of a heel problem that is about managing pain rather than a set recovery. He could be fit enough for Club Brugge if the pain allows.
He picked up a soleus injury on Netherlands duty and has not trained with Liverpool since. He was absent from the Manchester United matchday squad and is expected to miss Club Brugge.
He has returned to team training after knee surgery but is still not available. Liverpool will load him back in carefully.
He is training with the squad on alternate days after an ACL tear, and Iraola says he is still not available. Iraola hopes he can play in some weeks.
He is still recovering from an Achilles rupture from April. Iraola says the plan remains a return in January 2027, with an earlier return possible if all goes well.
He is listed as unavailable with a knee problem in the pre-Manchester United team news. No return date has been given.
